scope: Independent local authentication, configuration, request-budget and exact compiled-package verification. Frozen prior hold-only review remains unchanged.

resolvedFindings.finding: A token with only 61 seconds remaining could be captured by a reader for a 15-minute Queue invocation and expire during source reads.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Fixed 16-minute token safety margin covers the maximum consumer duration plus one minute; independent 900-second simulation passes with one exchange before the new consumer and no per-Admin OAuth call.

resolvedFindings.finding: The initial 5092-byte inline configuration was close to the documented 5 KB Cloudflare variable limit, whose decimal/binary interpretation was not established.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Split bindings of 1643 and 3461 UTF-8 bytes reconstruct the identical original configuration and fingerprint; missing, malformed or ambiguous binding rejects. This was a boundary risk, not proof of a rejected deployment.

resolvedFindings.finding: Initial integration receipt referenced a nonexistent prior-review filename.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final receipt points to the existing frozen review.json and repair receipt; both links verified.

initialSupersededRuntimeSuite.note: Historical initial authentication candidate, before the expiry and split-binding corrections. Not the final count.

independentExpiry.case: A warm cached token with 61 seconds remaining is replaced before the reader is created; 18 simulated 50-second Admin operations complete without another exchange or expired-token use.

limits: Real dedicated grant eligibility, scopes, full source read, cloud plan/resources and live refresh remain unverified.
No claim of Merchant source receipt or market buyer readiness.

finalRequestBudget.limitation: Counts one deterministic checkpoint branch; does not prove live CPU, memory, wall time, account quota or grant eligibility.

packagingDryRun.verification: Reviewer verified resulting bundle hashes, all 11 source-map contents, and exercised the compiled bundle locally with synthetic I/O.

authAssessment.request: POST form body; exact configured single-label myshopify.com host; redirect error and credentials omit
authAssessment.minimumCompleteScopeSet: NOT_PROVEN; the relevant six read-only families are an allowlist, not proof that each allowed subset is sufficient.
authAssessment.cache: Memory-only; hashed shop/client/secret key; concurrent acquisition joined; rotation isolates credentials; fixed 16-minute expiry margin.
authAssessment.explicitCloudMode: Requires client credentials and never reads/falls back to legacy Admin token.
authAssessment.failureBehavior: Constant sanitized errors; rejects unsafe scopes and malformed token responses; terminal FAILED status preserves the prior immutable pointer and public feed.

preservedHoldReview.savedSourceRegression: Prior review checked five saved snapshots: US/AU/CA/GB each 4741 rows after 162 available held and 22 unavailable variants; Spanish saved case 4552 rows with 189 translation exclusions. These are dated saved-source checks, not fresh live market proof.

reviewedActivationPlan.assessment: PASS_AS_GATED_PLAN; exact dedicated app and encrypted destination approval, real narrow-token collector proof, public-host acceptance, before-state/rollback and post-deploy receipts are retained.
reviewedActivationPlan.liveLimitation: Root receipts record no current cron, the prior host deployment, an unchanged 4741-row US pointer and one unresolved public HTTP 403. Reviewer read receipts only; public Google acceptance is not established.

activationConditions: Dedicated installed app must satisfy Shopify same-organization eligibility and exact owner approval of the six named read scopes.
Read back the actual new credential scopes and complete the exact full collector with that limited credential; do not silently broaden permissions or substitute the legacy broad Admin token.
Owner must approve the exact encrypted SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID and SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET destination at the named Cloudflare account and Worker. Generic authority is not credential-transfer authority.
Qualify and resolve the single public-host HTTP 403 before activation completion. That client result alone does not establish Google fetch failure.
Recheck current Worker deployment/settings, queue/bucket/pointer and supported account resources without billing changes; retain exact before-state and a tested, target-specific rollback.
Only under current exact authority create the isolated queue, install the approved encrypted bindings and deploy the reviewed bundle with matching split configuration; only us-en is enabled.
Observe a complete real cloud source collection and atomic promotion; verify current source partition, hosted byte count, SHA256, row count, country/language/currency and source age.
Confirm Merchant processing on existing US source 10727274744 and observe a later scheduled cloud run before certifying continuous operation.
Real Cloudflare CPU, memory, wall time and account quotas remain unverified by local tests; 41 external fetches is the bounded source-request premise, not full production capacity proof.
Additional markets require separate fresh buyer, landing, price, shipping, translation, policy and Google eligibility evidence; this candidate enables no additional market.
reproductionLimitations: Initial expiry reproduction is retained as historical evidence of the superseded code; it expected the old failure. It is not a passing current-regression command.
Initial source files are preserved under initial_source only as review evidence.
The prior Sep 11 freeze/readiness/dry-run artifacts do not certify this final package.
bin/build.mjs and bin/verify-queue.mjs default to config.example.json; any applicable rehearsal must explicitly pass --config config.json.
No real network calls were made by synthetic checks, and no private source credentials were inspected.
nextAction: Root obtains exact approval and verifies the dedicated read-only app and encrypted destination before any access transfer or activation.
continuation: Continue from this frozen review and activation_plan.json; preserve hashes and satisfy the named live gates before claiming deployment or continuous Merchant operation.
